title: Delta-Matching: Closing the Final Gap of Native 8-bit Training for LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2609.37852v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reliable FP8 attention remains a barrier to fully native 8-bit large language model training. We derive how forward-backward inconsistencies produce stale delta and empirically show how it distorts training dynamics. Our stale-delta hybrid runs show a modest loss gap at 569M parameters but substantial loss increases and downstream degradation at 1.67B and 5.29B. QK normalization, NoPE (no positional encoding), and lower-learning-rate context extension mitigate or delay degradation without eliminating it. This pattern suggests accumulated optimization error that smaller models and short runs can conceal. We propose Delta-Matching, proving that it restores the softmax gradient's zero-row-sum invariant under the stated numerical assumptions. It enables native block-scaled FP8 in every forward and backward attention-core matmul without architectural changes, smaller global batches, or auxiliary forward outputs. translated_title: Delta-Matching（增量匹配）：弥合大语言模型原生8位训练的最后差距
translated_abstract: 可靠的FP8注意力机制仍然是实现完全原生8位大语言模型训练的一大障碍。我们推导了前向-后向不一致如何产生陈旧增量，并实证展示了它如何扭曲训练动态。我们的陈旧增量混合实验显示，在5.69亿参数规模下损失差距较小，但在16.7亿和52.9亿参数规模下出现显著的损失增加和下游任务性能退化。QK归一化、NoPE（无位置编码）以及较低学习率的上下文扩展可以缓解或延迟这种退化，但无法将其消除。这一模式表明存在累积的优化误差，而较小的模型和短时间的训练过程可以掩盖这种误差。我们提出了Delta-Matching方法，并证明在给定的数值假设下，它能够恢复softmax梯度的行和为零不变式。该方法使每次前向和后向注意力核心矩阵乘法都能实现原生块缩放FP8计算，而无需更改架构、缩小全局批次或额外的辅助前向输出。在所测试的架构中……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出Delta-Matching方法，通过恢复softmax梯度的行和为零不变式来消除FP8注意力中前向-后向不一致产生的陈旧增量，从而在无需架构更改的情况下实现所有注意力核心矩阵乘法的原生8位训练。
en_tdlr: Delta-Matching restores the softmax gradient's zero-row-sum invariant to eliminate stale delta caused by forward-backward inconsistencies in FP8 attention, enabling native block-scaled FP8 in every attention-core matmul without architectural changes.
